job.brief: Example re-created from the 08 Oct 2026 concept report so Paul can see the contract filled in. Level 1 and Level 3 are filled from that report; Level 2 is not.

site.land_area_note: Prior report says 514 m2; mapped area 525.6 m2. Unresolved until survey.
site.existing_buildings: Existing contributory house (heritage area). Demolition approval not assumed.

level1.disclaimer: Desktop review only. Not a LIM, a zoning certificate or a consent opinion. Confirm with the council and your advisers before relying on it.
level1.summary: A narrow central-city site in the High Density Residential zone. Multi-level apartments are plausible, with about 22 m used as the height screening figure, but the site sits in a Residential Heritage Area with a contributory house, so demolition and redevelopment approval cannot be assumed.

what_you_can_do.option: Multi-level apartment building, around six levels
what_you_can_do.indicative_yield: About six residences on the Concept M footprint
what_you_can_do.note: Pathway depends on heritage, height in relation to boundary and shading assessments.

hazards.hazard: Heritage: Residential Heritage Area, contributory existing house
hazards.what_it_means: Demolition and new building need heritage assessment; approval is not assumed.
Reported 514 m2 against a mapped 525.6 m2. Needs survey before setbacks are relied on.

level3.disclaimer: Concept design, not for consent or construction. Renders are artist's impressions. Areas are gross design zones, not net saleable areas.

concept.summary: Six residences on a narrow central-city site: a ground-floor garden apartment beside a residents' wellness suite, and five full-floor three-bedroom homes above it. The approved red-brick character, Concept M footprint and original lift and stair core are retained.
key_points: Six residences, one per upper floor
Full-floor penthouse with an open west balcony
Ground-floor sauna, spa garden, gym and lounge
10 x 3 m west balcony on every upper floor
Four car stacker positions, up to eight spaces (to be confirmed)
concept.architecture: Red brick, dark framed glazing, pale balcony edges and restrained cedar accents.
